description: Source code for managing security daemon groups and their members, including process control, event handling, and runtime actions.

classes.name: wld_secDmnGrp
classes.description: Represents a group of security daemon members with process control and event handling capabilities.

classes.name: wld_secDmnGrp_member_t
classes.description: Represents a member of a security daemon group, including its state and event handlers.

methods.name: s_restartProcCb

methods.name: s_getArgsProcCb

methods.name: s_preStartProcCb
